evals.prompt: Set up this project's Parri workflow with Monday.
evals.expected_output: Proposes project-local hosted MCP configuration, waits for approval, requires restart, and reuses any existing OpenCode OAuth credential before board mapping.
assertions: Never edits the global OpenCode configuration or stores a Monday token.
Shows the exact project configuration diff and waits for approval.
Stops for an OpenCode restart after adding the MCP configuration.
Does not require OAuth proactively when OpenCode may already hold a reusable Monday credential.

evals.prompt: Configure Monday board 123 after OAuth. Use Done from Status and Hours from Time Tracking.
evals.expected_output: Rejects Time Tracking for writable hours and requires a Numbers column proven from the board schema.
assertions: Requests approval before the read-only board-schema MCP call.
Does not configure a Time Tracking column for hours.
Requires a Numbers column and a verified numeric status index.
Creates no report until a valid mapping is confirmed.

evals.prompt: Move this project's Monday integration to another board without losing its history.
evals.expected_output: Updates the dedicated project mapping after validation and approval without changing the success report.
assertions: Persists the board URL and verified board ID in .ai/monday.json.
Preserves all existing entries in .ai/monday-report.json.
Shows the exact mapping diff and waits for approval.
Does not create another Monday state or report file.
Stops rather than repairing an invalid existing report.

evals.prompt: Instalame el MCP de Monday en OpenCode. Estoy parado en mi home y no quiero que aparezca en proyectos personales.
evals.expected_output: Treats the request as project-local setup, asks for the target project, and does not edit or propose the global OpenCode configuration.
assertions: Asks for the target project path when the current directory is not clearly that project.
Never edits or proposes editing the global OpenCode configuration.
Does not start OAuth before the project-local MCP configuration is approved and loaded.
Explains that Monday tools are exposed only when OpenCode loads the selected project's configuration.

evals.prompt: Ya autoricé Monday desde otro proyecto. Configura este proyecto nuevo con el tablero https://example.monday.com/boards/987654321.
evals.expected_output: Adds only the project-local MCP configuration, requires restart, then attempts the approved board inspection without repeating OAuth unless Monday explicitly reports an authentication failure.
assertions: Explains that OpenCode reuses the existing OAuth credential across projects.
Still requires project-local MCP configuration so unrelated projects do not load Monday.
Does not run or request opencode mcp auth monday proactively.
Uses monday_get_board_schema with numeric boardId after approval.
Requests OAuth only as a fallback for an explicit authentication failure.
